overall: The AG found the council did not violate the Open Meeting Law by holding its October 23, 2012 real estate executive session under Purpose 6, and declined the Charter and c. 30B claims. A reminder about announcing the Purpose 6 detriment declaration was given, not an order.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the council discussed topics at its October 23, 2012 executive session that were not proper for executive session.
allegations.key_passage: The Council discussed negotiations and pricing for those properties, which was appropriate under Purpose 6.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged that discussion of the use of potential properties during that executive session fell outside the permitted purpose.
allegations.key_passage: While there was some discussion regarding the use of certain properties, the context of that discussion was concerning the negotiation and purchase price of property, therefore it also was appropriate and no violation occurred.
